title: Score of Parentheses
statement: The score of '()' is 1. The score of AB is score(A) + score(B). The score of (A) is 2 * score(A). `s` is a balanced parentheses string. Return its score.
hints: A stack of scores handles nesting. Push 0 on '(' as a frame.
On ')', pop the frame. If it is 0, the pair was (), worth 1. Otherwise the frame is an inner score and the value is twice that.
Add the value onto the new top, which accumulates adjacent groups.

approaches.name: Recursion on matching pairs
approaches.explanation: Find the span of each top-level group.

editorial: Start with a stack containing 0, the score of the content outside everything. '(' pushes a fresh 0. ')' pops the inner score, turns 0 into 1 or doubles a positive score, and adds that onto the frame now on top. The only remaining value is the score of the whole string.
